news.title: Zambia U15 squad departs for inaugural FIFA World Cup in Azerbaijan
news.lede: Zambia’s Under-15 boys’ national team has departed Lusaka for Baku, Azerbaijan, ahead of the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival, which runs from 24 to 31 October 2026. The Junior Chipolopolo left Kenneth Kaunda International Airport at 21:00 on Tuesday, beginning their journey to the week-long international competition. Head coach Brian Kunsanama has named a 13-player squad for the tournament, with the team featuring young prospects drawn from secondary schools, primary schools and football academies across the country. The squad includes two goalkeepers, three defenders, five midfielders and three strikers as Zambia prepares to test its emerging talent on the international stage.

news.title: FIFA Plans Rule Change Following Controversial Balogun World Cup Suspension
news.lede: Rabat - FIFA is preparing to change its disciplinary rules following the controversy surrounding American striker Folarin Balogun, whose automatic suspension was lifted during the 2026 World Cup after US President Donald Trump contacted FIFA President Gianni Infantino. The proposed amendment would prevent automatic one-match suspensions from being suspended in similar circumstances, following criticism of FIFA's decision to allow Balogun to participate in the tournament's knockout stages. The issue was discussed during a FIFA Council meeting in Zurich on October 15, where officials agreed to review the disciplinary procedures involved in the case. According to the Royal Belgian Football Association (RBFA), FIFA has committed to amending Article 27 of its Disciplinary Code, with the proposed changes expected to be submitted for approval at the next Council meeting in Doha on December 16.

news.title: Morocco to Host 2027 Women’s World Cup Playoff Preliminary Round
news.lede: Rabat – The International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) has selected Morocco to host the preliminary round of the playoff tournament for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup, scheduled to take place from November 28 to December 5, 2026. According to FIFA’s official announcement , the matches will take place at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Salé, near Rabat. Six national teams will participate in the competition: South Africa, Ghana, Ecuador, Uzbekistan, Chinese Taipei, and Papua New Guinea. The tournament will feature nine matches, with each team playing three games.
